name.fr-FR: Introduction à la vie et aux vertus chrétiennes
name.en-US: Introduction to the Christian Life and Virtues
name.pt-BR: Introdução à vida e às virtudes cristãs

description.fr-FR: Quinze chapitres sur la religion de Jésus-Christ et la vie chrétienne, puis sur les vertus : humilité, pénitence, mortification, patience, douceur, pauvreté, chasteté, obéissance, charité.
description.en-US: Fifteen chapters on the religion of Jesus Christ and the Christian life, then on the virtues: humility, penance, mortification, patience, meekness, poverty, chastity, obedience, charity.
description.pt-BR: Quinze capítulos sobre a religião de Jesus Cristo e a vida cristã, depois sobre as virtudes: humildade, penitência, mortificação, paciência, mansidão, pobreza, castidade, obediência, caridade.

sources.edition: Œuvres complètes de M. Olier, éd. Migne, Paris, 1856; archive.org OCR (ABBYY) of the Toronto copy.
sources.description: Machine-cleaned OCR: running heads, page numbers and hyphenation removed, paragraphs rejoined, obvious character errors corrected by a vote against the corpus vocabulary. Residual OCR errors remain (see PROBLEMS.md).
sources.tierEvidence: Olier died in 1657; the 1856 edition is public domain.
